en.answer: Even in that case, since the effect that doubles damage has already been applied, the battle or effect damage the opponent takes this turn will be doubled once.
en.question: After returning the banished cards to the Graveyard by the effect of <<11961>>, if <<11961>> has its effects negated by <<5740>>, what happens with the part of the effect that doubles damage?
en.title: After returning the banished cards to the Graveyard by the effect of <<11961>>, if <<11961>> has its effects negated by <<5740>>, what happens with the part of the effect that doubles damage?

ja.answer: 「<<11961>>」の除外された相手のカードを墓地へ戻す処理の適用後、「<<11961>>」の効果が「<<5740>>」によって無効になっている場合でも、『相手が受ける戦闘・効果ダメージは１度だけ倍になる』効果は既に適用されていますので、このターンに相手が受ける戦闘・効果ダメージは1度だけ倍になります。
